title: Public mobilization over Farakka water diversion
detail: Political groups and civic actors intensified campaigning over reduced dry-season flow of the Ganges/Padma and framed the issue as a question of national water rights.

title: Maulana Bhashani leads the Farakka Long March
detail: A mass procession began from Rajshahi toward the Chapainawabganj-Kansat frontier near Farakka, demanding fair Ganges water sharing and protesting unilateral upstream diversion.

title: Water-sharing issue gains state-level diplomatic traction
detail: After the march, Bangladesh's Ganges-water question gained stronger policy visibility and remained central to subsequent bilateral and international negotiations.
